# Set-Up

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
library(car)
library(corrplot)
library(randomForest)
library(patchwork)
library(pdp)

plots <- st_read("data/processed/fuels_analysis.gpkg", layer = "allplotsDS") 
plots$northness[is.na(plots$northness)] <- 0
plots$eastness[is.na(plots$eastness)] <- 0

colnames(plots)

plots <- plots %>%
  mutate(across(c("northness", "eastness", "elevation", "slope", "TMax", "PR", "VS", "VPD", "ERC", "TOTAL_COUNT", "prop_Thinning", "prop_Wildfire", "prop_Broadcast.Burn", "prop_Removal", "prop_extent_treated", "TCC", "prop_aspen", "prop_lodgepole", "prop_mixed.conifer", "prop_other", "prop_pinyon.juniper", "prop_ponderosa", "prop_spruce.fir"), as.numeric))

```

# Look at all individual linear relationships
```{r}
predictors <- c("northness", "eastness", "elevation", "slope", "TMax", "PR", "VS",
                 "VPD", "ERC", "TOTAL_COUNT", "prop_Thinning", "prop_Wildfire",
                 "prop_Broadcast.Burn", "prop_Removal", "prop_extent_treated", "TCC",
                 "prop_aspen", "prop_lodgepole", "prop_mixed.conifer",
                 "prop_pinyon.juniper", "prop_ponderosa", "prop_spruce.fir", "prop_other")

plot_list_high <- lapply(predictors, function(var) {
  ggplot(plots, aes(x = .data[[var]], y = prop_high_sev)) +
    geom_point() +
    geom_smooth(method = "loess")
})

names(plot_list_high) <- predictors

wrap_plots(plot_list_high, ncol = 4)

plot_list_mohi <- lapply(predictors, function(var) {
  ggplot(plots, aes(x = .data[[var]], y = prop_mod_high_sev)) +
    geom_point() +
    geom_smooth(method = "loess")
})

names(plot_list_mohi) <- predictors

wrap_plots(plot_list_mohi, ncol = 4)
```

# Calculate VIF scores

```{r}
model <- lm(prop_high_sev ~ northness + eastness + elevation + slope + TMax + PR + VS + VPD + ERC + TOTAL_COUNT + prop_Thinning + prop_Wildfire + prop_Broadcast.Burn + prop_Removal + prop_extent_treated + TCC + prop_aspen + prop_lodgepole + prop_mixed.conifer + prop_pinyon.juniper + prop_ponderosa + prop_spruce.fir, data = plots)

vif_scores <- vif(model)
print(vif_scores)

#removing individual treatment types, TMax, individual EVTs
model2 <- lm(prop_high_sev ~ northness + eastness + elevation + slope + PR + VS + VPD + ERC + TOTAL_COUNT + prop_extent_treated + TCC + prop_ponderosa, data = plots)

vif_scores <- vif(model2)
print(vif_scores)



#Correlation matrix
plots_corr <- plots %>% st_drop_geometry()
cor(plots_corr[, c("northness", "eastness", "elevation", "slope", "TMax", "PR", "VS", "VPD", "ERC", "TOTAL_COUNT", "prop_Thinning", "prop_Wildfire", "prop_Broadcast.Burn", "prop_Removal", "prop_extent_treated", "TCC", "prop_aspen", "prop_lodgepole", "prop_mixed.conifer", "prop_other", "prop_pinyon.juniper", "prop_ponderosa", "prop_spruce.fir")], use = "complete.obs")
```

# Random Forest - Prop high severity

```{r}
# Prepare and split data (80% Train, 20% Test)
set.seed(123) # Ensures identical bootstrap results
index <- sample(1:nrow(plots), 0.8 * nrow(plots))
train_data <- plots[index, ]
test_data  <- plots[-index, ]

# Fit the model 
high_model <- randomForest(
  prop_high_sev ~ northness + eastness + elevation + slope + PR + VS + VPD + ERC + TOTAL_COUNT + prop_extent_treated + TCC + prop_ponderosa,          # Formula: target ~ predictors
  data = train_data,    # Training dataset
  ntree = 500,          # Total decision trees grown
  mtry = 2,             # Features split per node
  importance = TRUE     # Evaluates feature impact
)

# Print out-of-bag (OOB) error summary
print(high_model)

# Generate predictions on test data
predictions <- predict(high_model, newdata = test_data)

# Calculate Regression Evaluation Metrics
actuals <- test_data$prop_high_sev

# 1. Root Mean Squared Error (Average prediction error size)
rmse <- sqrt(mean((actuals - predictions)^2))
cat("Test RMSE:", round(rmse, 4), "\n")

# 2. R-squared on Test Data (Proportion of variance explained)
r2 <- 1 - (sum((actuals - predictions)^2) / sum((actuals - mean(actuals))^2))
cat("Test R-squared:", round(r2, 4), "\n")

```

# Plots - high severity

```{r}
plot(high_model)
importance(high_model)
varImpPlot(high_model)
```

Partial dependence plots

```{r}
clean_train <- as.data.frame(train_data)

# 2. Extract all predictor names directly from your randomForest model object
# This prevents you from having to type out all 15 variable names manually
predictors <- rownames(high_model$importance)

# 3. Create a folder to store the plots (if it doesn't already exist)
output_dir <- "documents/pdp_plots"
if(!dir.exists(output_dir)) {
  dir.create(output_dir)
}

# 4. Loop through each variable, generate the PDP, and save it
for (var_name in predictors) {
  
  # Print progress to console
  cat("Generating and saving plot for:", var_name, "\n")
  
  # Compute partial dependence using the clean data frame
  pdp_data <- partial(
    high_model, 
    pred.var = var_name, 
    train = clean_train
  )
  
  # Build a clean ggplot2 visualization
  p <- autoplot(pdp_data) + 
    labs(
      title = paste("Partial Dependence Plot:", var_name),
      x = var_name,
      y = "Predicted prop_high_sev"
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 11)
    )
  
  # Construct a safe filename (e.g., pdp_plots/pdp_elevation.png)
  file_path <- file.path(output_dir, paste0(var_name, "hi_pdp", ".png"))
  
  # Save the plot with professional dimensions
  ggsave(
    filename = file_path, 
    plot = p, 
    width = 6, 
    height = 4.5, 
    dpi = 300
  )
}

cat("\nAll plots have been saved successfully to the '", output_dir, "' directory!\n", sep="")
```

# Random Forest - Prop mod-high severity

- 7/9 removing proportion extent treated for now

```{r}
# Prepare and split data (80% Train, 20% Test)
set.seed(123) # Ensures identical bootstrap results
index <- sample(1:nrow(plots), 0.8 * nrow(plots))
train_data <- plots[index, ]
test_data  <- plots[-index, ]

# Fit the model 
mohi_model <- randomForest(
  prop_mod_high_sev ~ northness + eastness + elevation + slope + TMax + PR + VS + ERC + TOTAL_COUNT + prop_Thinning + prop_Wildfire + prop_Broadcast.Burn + prop_Removal + TCC + prop_aspen + prop_lodgepole + prop_mixedconifer + prop_other + prop_pinyonjuniper + prop_ponderosa + prop_sprucefir,          # Formula: target ~ predictors
  data = train_data,    # Training dataset
  ntree = 500,          # Total decision trees grown
  mtry = 2,             # Features split per node
  importance = TRUE     # Evaluates feature impact
)

# Print out-of-bag (OOB) error summary
print(mohi_model)

# Generate predictions on test data
predictions <- predict(mohi_model, newdata = test_data)

# Calculate Regression Evaluation Metrics
actuals <- test_data$prop_mod_high_sev

# 1. Root Mean Squared Error (Average prediction error size)
rmse <- sqrt(mean((actuals - predictions)^2))
cat("Test RMSE:", round(rmse, 4), "\n")

# 2. R-squared on Test Data (Proportion of variance explained)
r2 <- 1 - (sum((actuals - predictions)^2) / sum((actuals - mean(actuals))^2))
cat("Test R-squared:", round(r2, 4), "\n")

```

